title: Ning Li email intercepted by West Point IP
summary: Dave Rossi tells of Ning Li email intercepted by West Point IP, about early 2000s at West Point / Huntsville, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um the email messaging was then intercepted by an IP address from West Point. And then from there, you never heard from her again.

plain: Dave Rossi, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a story about a woman named Ning Li from the early 2000s. He says her emails were intercepted by a computer address traced to West Point, the US Army's military academy in New York, and that after that no one ever heard from her again. Told this way, it hints that someone in the military was watching her work closely.
